sources.title: Maison Lameloise — Relais & Châteaux restaurant page
sources.claim: Three-Michelin-star restaurant under chef Éric Pras; Dégustation menu €335.

sources.title: thienlan.me — La Lameloise diary
sources.claim: Diner's first-hand timestamp: dinner ran 20:00 → 01:00, roughly five hours.

sources.title: Hôtel Lameloise official site
sources.claim: 16 air-conditioned rooms at 36 Place d'Armes — six categories from Standard to Grand Deluxe.

sources.title: Hôtel de la Poste — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: 3-star, 11 rooms, 2-min walk to Lameloise, ~$93–$112/night, 8.3/10 Booking.

sources.title: Château La Commaraine, Pommard
sources.claim: 12th-century Pommard estate reopening in 2026; stay puts the tasting at the foot of the staircase.

sources.title: Hostellerie de Levernois
sources.claim: Five-star Relais & Châteaux at Levernois with its own Michelin star.

sources.title: Le Hameau de Barboron — Booking
sources.claim: Cistercian farmhouse at Savigny-lès-Beaune scoring 9.3/10 on guest reviews.

sources.title: Le Taxi Bourguignon
sources.claim: Chagny-based taxi, 24/7, takes 'sortie de soirée' runs — pre-book the return when you book the table.

sources.title: Château de Chassagne-Montrachet B&B
sources.claim: Bader-Mimeur estate accepts overnight guests; cellar tour is included.

sources.title: Voie des Vignes — Beaune→Santenay (France Vélo Tourisme)
sources.claim: 23 km e-bike loop through Pommard, Meursault, Chassagne, Santenay.

sources.title: Hospices de Beaune — FAQ
sources.claim: Hôtel-Dieu is open every day of the year, including Sundays.

sources.title: Beginner's guide to Michelin-starred meals
sources.claim: Keep daytime calories light — skip a heavy lunch before a tasting menu.

sources.title: Maison Lameloise — reservations
sources.claim: Closed Tuesdays + Wednesdays year-round; closed 18 Aug → 2 Sep 2026 (reopens Thu 3 Sep).

sources.title: France Bleu — Château de La Rochepot confiscation
sources.claim: Property officially confiscated 12 March 2026; visit-closed indefinitely.

sources.title: Forum InCyber des Territoires — Le Creusot
sources.claim: Cybersecurity event at Hub & Go on Thu–Fri 11–12 June 2026 — threads into a Sat 13 June dinner.

sources.title: Hôtel-Dieu ticketing — opening hours
sources.claim: Open 9:00–19:30 continuously 1 Apr → 15 Nov 2026.

sources.title: Beaune Saturday market
sources.claim: Every Saturday 7:00–13:00 across Place de la Halle, Place Fleury and avenue de la République; ~180 stalls.

sources.title: Patriarche Père & Fils — visit page
sources.claim: Largest cellar in Burgundy (5 km galleries); self-guided audio tour with sommelier-poured 6-wine tasting.

sources.title: Rick Steves community — Burgundy on a Sunday
sources.claim: Most Burgundy cellars are closed Sundays; Patriarche, Bouchard Aîné, Marché aux Vins and Jaffelin are the exceptions.

sources.title: Chagny Sunday market
sources.claim: Chagny's own weekly food market runs Sunday morning on Place de la République.

sources.title: ViaMichelin — Chagny → Beaune
sources.claim: 16 km / 32-minute drive.

sources.title: Château de Pommard — experiences
sources.claim: Tastings €30–€260; free cancellation up to 2 h before; reservation up to 4 h before.
